tools.name: run_scheduled_post_publisher
tools.description: Runs the publishing job for a scheduled post and sends its text and media to the connected social network's API. Returns the live post URL.

params.name: post_id
params.description: ID of the scheduled post to publish

params.name: platform
params.description: Target network such as twitter, linkedin or facebook

tools.name: summarize_campaign_engagement
tools.description: Looks up engagement metrics for a campaign over a date range and returns totals and rates per platform, plus the top performing posts.

params.name: top_n
params.description: Number of top posts to include

tools.name: reschedule_draft_post
tools.description: Updates the scheduled publish time of a draft post and returns the saved post record with its new time.

params.name: new_publish_at
params.description: New publish time in ISO 8601 format

tools.name: find_unanswered_mentions
tools.description: Fetches recent mentions and comments for a brand account from the network API and lists those that have not been replied to, oldest first.

params.name: max_age_hours
params.description: Only include mentions newer than this many hours

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of mentions to return
